ERC20 allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.

Constructor: mints reflections, sets fees, router, pair and exemptions.
_transfer: validates, applies limits, triggers swapAndLiquify and routes to _tokenTransfer.
swapAndLiquify: splits contract tokens, swaps for ETH, adds liquidity and pays marketing/dev.
swapTokensForEth: approves and swaps tokens for ETH via router.
addLiquidity: approves and adds liquidity with ETH via router.
_tokenTransfer: selects buy/sell fee set and dispatches to a transfer variant.
_getTValues: computes token fee components and transfer amount.
_getRValues: converts token amounts into reflection amounts.
_getCurrentSupply: iterates excluded accounts to derive current supplies.
_takeLiquidity: credits liquidity fee to the contract.
_takeWalletFee: credits marketing/dev fee to the contract.
_takeDonationFee: credits donation fee to the donation address.
removeAllFee: zeroes all active fee variables.
setBuy: loads buyFee into active fee variables.
setSell: loads sellFee into active fee variables.
transferFrom: external ERC20 entry point with allowance deduction.
deliver: burns reflection from caller and increases tFeeTotal.
tokenFromReflection: converts reflection amount to token amount.
reflectionFromToken: converts token amount to reflection amount.
balanceOf: returns excluded tOwned or reflection-derived balance.
unlock: restores ownership after lock time has passed.
lock: locks ownership for a duration and sets _lockTime.
setBothFees: owner updates buy and sell fee structs.
removeBotFromBlacklist: owner removes an address from blacklist.
excludeFromReward: owner excludes an account from reflection.
includeInReward: owner re-includes an account in reflection.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled: owner toggles swap and liquify.
receive: accepts ETH from router swaps.
transferOwnership: owner transfers ownership to a new address.
tx.origin: used for blacklist gating in _transfer.
payable(_marketingAddress).transfer(marketingAmt) sends ETH to a mutable wallet address.
_devwallet.transfer(devAmt) sends ETH to a mutable wallet address.
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH{value: ethAmount} external payable call with zero slippage bounds.
Unchecked fee-split arithmetic in swapAndLiquify (denominator, unitBalance, bnbToAddLiquidityWith) vulnerable to division by zero / overflow with uint16 fee sums.
New wallet address parameter of updateMarketingWallet.
Amount parameter of the calculate*Fee helpers.
Local currentRate used in fee-taking helpers.
Local swap path array in swapTokensForEth.

edges.reason: msg.sender flows into _transfer as the sender/blacklist subject.
tx.origin is used to gate transfers via the bot blacklist.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify (external calls) before completing state accounting.
swapAndLiquify performs an ETH transfer to the marketing wallet.
swapAndLiquify performs an ETH transfer to the dev wallet.
swapAndLiquify performs unchecked fee-split arithmetic and division by denominator.
swapTokensForEth executes the router swap external call.
addLiquidity executes the router addLiquidityETH external call.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline.
Router/pair token transfers can re-enter _transfer while swapAndLiquify is mid-flight.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee before and after dispatch.
_tokenTransfer calls setBuy when sender is the pair.
_tokenTransfer calls setSell when recipient is the pair.
setBuy writes _taxFee and other active fees.
setSell writes active fee variables from sellFee.
Constructor creates and stores the uniswap pair.
Constructor sets fee/limit exemptions for the marketing wallet.
setMaxTxPercent computes and writes _maxTxAmount with mul/div.
setMaxWalletSizePercent computes and writes _maxWalletSize with mul/div.
unlock performs ownership state reassignment without reentrancy protection.
_transfer relies on inSwapAndLiquify as its only reentrancy guard.
_transfer enforces blacklist checks on from, msg.sender and tx.origin.
Blacklist account parameter flows into addBotToBlacklist.
numTokens parameter flows into the swap threshold setter.
Amount parameter is multiplied by the active fee percentage.
contractTokenBalance is compared against swap and limit thresholds.
denominator is derived from uint16 fee sums and used as divisor.
tokensToAddLiquidityWith is computed with unchecked multiplication/division.
toSwap is computed by subtraction from tokens.
initialBalance snapshots contract ETH balance before the swap.
deltaBalance is derived from balance difference after external swap.
unitBalance divides deltaBalance by the fee denominator.
marketingAmt is sent out to the marketing wallet via transfer.
devAmt is sent out to the dev wallet via transfer.
currentRate converts token fee amounts to reflection amounts.
path array defines the token->WETH swap route.
